basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Project Attendant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

important_dates.interview_date: To be announced (informed via email for online interview)

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | project attendant: Minimum Qualification: 12th grade pass. Experience Required: Minimum of 2 years of working experience in MRI and imaging lab. Candidate is expected to maintain lab, coordinate with IIT staff for any work related to maintenance of lab (such as civil, electrical, cleanliness etc.), make arrangements for lab and faculty meetings, visit collaborating hospitals for project related work. Candidate need to email the scanned copy of certificate of above mentioned work experience from the PI or HOD.

salary_details.details: In case of selection of a retired/superannuated government employee, his/her salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms.

selection_process: The selection process consists of short-listing of eligible candidates followed by an online interview.
IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing of eligible candidates from those satisfying advertised qualification and requirement of the project post
and their name will be displayed on the web link (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted) along with the online interview details. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for online interview.
how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD Website at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec.
Fill up the application form completely with information regarding educational qualifications, percentage of marks/division, and details of work experience.
Attach the scanned copy of the certificate of work experience from the PI or HOD.
Send the completed application by email to Prof. Anup Singh at email id: [email protected].
Mention the Advertisement No. on the subject line of the email.
Ensure the application reaches by 23/10/2026 by 5:00 p.m.
important_instructions: Appointment will be on a contractual basis with consolidated pay, renewable yearly or upto the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. Candidate need to email the scanned copy of certificate of work experience from the PI or HOD. 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to the SC/ST candidates in case of selection of a retired/superannuated government employee or as per prevailing IRD norms for respective categories. In case any clarification is required on eligibility regarding the above post, the candidate may contact to Prof. Anup Singh at email id: [email protected].

faq.question: Q1. What is the IIT Delhi Project Attendant recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by IIT Delhi for 1 vacancy of Project Attendant under the Centre for Biomedical Engineering on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under IIT Delhi Project Attendant recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Project Attendant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Project Attendant post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit completed applications by email is 23/10/2026 by 5:00 p.m.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for IIT Delhi Project Attendant?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 12th grade with a minimum of 2 years of working experience in an MRI and imaging lab.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for IIT Delhi Project Attendant?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated fellowship or pay-slab of Rs. 30,000/- p.m.
